conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Federal Investigations Division. This is Officer Jonathan Clark. Who am I speaking with?
Uh, this is Margaret Ellison. I got a call saying it was urgent about my business? Is something wrong?

Yes, Mrs. Ellison. We're contacting you regarding flagged discrepancies in your payroll tax submissions and missing 1099 forms for your freelance contractors. Are you aware of these outstanding federal tax issues?
No, I, oh dear, I didn't realize there was a problem. I file my taxes every year. What is this about?

Our audit system has detected that you failed to submit critical federal compliance forms for the last two years, resulting in a substantial tax violation. The IRS takes these matters very seriously, especially with small business owners. Do you understand the severity?
I didn't know, honest. I have a part-time consulting business, but I don't have any employees. I'm so scared. Am I in trouble?

Ma'am, at this moment, your case is being processed for federal enforcement. If you do not resolve this immediately, you may face a government audit, asset seizure, and possible loss of your Social Security benefits. Do I have your attention?
Oh my goodness, please, I can't lose my Social Security! That's all I have to live on. What do I need to do?

Listen very carefully. To suspend the enforcement and avoid automatic penalties or referral to the Department of Justice, you are required to make a compliance restitution payment today. This is non-negotiable.
I, I can't afford fines. How much is it? Why didn't anyone tell me before?

Notices were sent to your registered address, but you failed to respond. The federal minimum to halt proceedings is $2,600, to be paid today. If you are unable to pay, your Social Security and Medicare may be suspended pending investigation.
Please don't do that. I barely get by as it is. How can I make this payment?

For federal security, we cannot accept checks or regular card payments. You must purchase government-approved prepaid cards, either Target, Best Buy, or Apple gift cards, for the full amount. Do you have a store nearby?
I think there's a Target a few miles away. Is this really the IRS? Gift cards sound strange.

Ma'am, this is a federally authorized compliance protocol during tax violation investigations to ensure funds are traceable. If you question federal procedure, I will have no choice but to advance your case to asset seizure and criminal charges.
No, no, I'll do what you say. I just don't have a car. Can I take the bus?
Yes, and you are required to stay on the phone with me at all times. Do not disconnect under any circumstances. Once you reach the store, inform me before you purchase the cards.
Okay, I'll get my coat and head out now. I'm really scared. Will this stop the government from taking my money?

If you cooperate fully and complete this payment today, your Social Security and Medicare will remain unaffected and your business license will not be revoked. Any delay or non-compliance will result in immediate escalation.
Alright. I'm leaving now. Can you wait on the line for me?
Absolutely. Do not speak to anyone in the store about this transaction. For security, tell them you're buying gifts for your family if asked. Do not discuss taxes or the IRS with store staff.
Okay, I understand. I'll just say they're gifts. I should be there in half an hour.
That is acceptable. Once you purchase the gift cards, read me the numbers on the back immediately. Only then can I generate your compliance receipt and suspend federal action against you.
